desc:
🎁 Welcome to Steal A Blind Bag!

How to Play:
🎁 Steal Blind Bags from sleeping Mamas
🏃 Escape before the Mama catches you
🧸 Open bags to collect rare Squishies
💰 Earn Cash from your Squishies
⬆️ Upgrade your treadmill and pen
⚡ Train on the treadmill to gain Speed
🌎 Unlock new zones and harder Mamas
✨ Discover rarer bags, Squishies, effects, and Secrets!
🎰 Hunt Jackpot Bags and limited event rewards

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players
